messages:
eva: hitting a 400 from /invoke-tool for customer acct 4821. Response: JSON schema validation error 'additionalProperties not allowed' on /params even though payload keys are the ones the SDK docs show. blocking billing pipeline. repro below.

eva: payload we send (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "payments.process",
  "params": {
    "customer_id": 4821,
    "amount": "100",
    "currency": "USD",
    "clientLogging": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  },
  "meta": {"trace_id": "t-9f3b"}
}
```

matt: can you paste the full response body + request id? quick look: amount as string could cause validator coercion to fail. also extra nested key clientLogging looks suspicious.

eva: request-id: r-20260317-9aef. response body:
```
{"error":"validation_failed","details":[{"path":"/params","message":"additionalProperties not allowed","extra":"clientLogging"}]}
```

support-bot: NOTE: schema-validator v2.3 (prod) rejected payload: error path=/params, rule=additionalProperties, key=clientLogging. Validator does strict object membership by default.

sara: I tried reproducing with the JS SDK — same 400. SDK v1.4 is serializing numeric ids as numbers but amounts as strings when a format helper is applied. If validator sees amount as string it returns type error, but our top-level validator currently surfaces additionalProperties which is confusing.

ingrid: digging in router: the request matched tool 'payments.legacy.process' (legacy schema is strict, additionalProperties=false). Newer tool 'payments.v2' schema allows clientLogging and nullable amounts (coerces). Looks like routing selected legacy because tenant routing table still points to legacy for this customer.

matt: possible mitigations: 1) strip unknown keys in gateway (fast patch), 2) route this tenant to payments.v2, 3) relax validator to allow additionalProperties for /params for a short window. Ops, which is fastest?  @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: fastest is gateway stripping unknown keys (hotfix). I can flip a request-sanitizer setting per-tenant in ~10m. Can also flip routing but that requires canary and config rollout (~45m).

eva: customer needs unblock asap — billing jobs failing every minute. please proceed with sanitizer per-tenant if low risk. also need a clear repro so support can confirm when fixed.

ingrid: I'll prepare a tiny canary: patch gateway to drop unknown keys for tenant 4821 and add a temporary transform to coerce amount string->int. will run smoke and report back (ETA 25m).

sara: repro steps for eng:
1) curl that payload to https://api.redwood.dev/v1/invoke-tool with header Authorization: Bearer <token-for-4821>
2) observe 400 with additionalProperties error
3) after gateway sanitizer enabled, same curl should return 200 or a validation success response from payments.v2/legacy fallback

matt: when you push the sanitizer, please include the request-id header in logs so we can trace. also add a short unit test to catch the "amount-as-string" case and clientLogging extra-field.

ops-oncall: sanitizer enabled for tenant=4821 (hotfix roll forward). verifying logs now.

support-bot: AUTO: Change deployed -> sanitizer per-tenant=4821 (edge) by ops-oncall; monitor=true.

eva: just retried curl after fix — success! returned 200 and job requeued. thank you :tada:

ingrid: follow-up: we should add a schema-tolerance flag to the gateway that can be toggled per-tenant, and update routing table to prefer payments.v2 for tenants with feature flag 'use_payments_v2'. I'll file an RFC/PR with suggested changes.

matt: agree. also add clearer validator errors (report both type mismatches and additionalProperties) so support and customers don't get misled.

eva: leaving this thread for postmortem notes. will attach logs and timeline in the ticket. thanks everyone. :heart:
